assertions.name: PostgreSQL schema contains authentication fields and revocable sessions

assertions.name: Public homepage renders
Opening the dashboard calls live health and account endpoints
assertions.evidence: Account registered; hashed session persisted; authenticated balance read = 120

assertions.name: Adding 25 credits updates the UI and the actual database row
assertions.evidence: POST /api/credits/1/add = 200; UI and direct SQL both report 145

assertions.name: Reloading re-reads the persisted account balance
assertions.evidence: Browser reload reads 145 through the backend; privileged key is not persisted

assertions.name: Deducting 40 credits updates the UI and the actual database row
assertions.evidence: POST /api/credits/1/deduct = 200; UI and direct SQL both report 105

assertions.name: Resetting sends PATCH and persists zero
assertions.evidence: PATCH /api/credits/1/reset = 200; UI and direct SQL both report 0

assertions.name: Backend rejects a zero-amount add without changing the database
assertions.evidence: POST amount=0 = 422; balance remains 0

assertions.name: Backend rejects over-deduction even on direct API calls
assertions.evidence: POST deduct from zero = 400 Insufficient credits; balance remains 0

assertions.name: Credit endpoints reject unauthenticated reads and writes
assertions.evidence: Read and write attempts without a bearer session return 401; balance is unchanged

assertions.name: A signed-in user still needs the administrator key to mutate credits
assertions.evidence: A valid session alone, incorrect key, and schema-only key cannot modify credit balances

assertions.name: An authenticated account cannot access another user's balance
assertions.evidence: A different existing user's account is concealed with HTTP 404

assertions.name: Invalid passwords and duplicate registrations are rejected
assertions.evidence: Incorrect credentials return 401; duplicate email cannot create a second account

assertions.name: Missing user shows the real backend 404 in the frontend
assertions.evidence: GET /api/credits/999999 = 404; visible account-not-found message

assertions.name: Admin screen displays the real 401 from an incorrect API key
assertions.evidence: GET /api/schema/migrations with bad key = 401

assertions.name: Correct admin key loads migration history from PostgreSQL
assertions.evidence: GET /api/schema/migrations with correct key = 200

assertions.name: Browser migration submission creates an index and audit record
assertions.evidence: POST /api/schema/apply = 200; SQL confirms the index and exactly one migration record

assertions.name: Migration API rejects destructive and multi-statement SQL
assertions.evidence: Destructive, multi-statement, table-copy, rename, and unapproved-column submissions are rejected

assertions.name: Repeated migration name is idempotently skipped
assertions.evidence: Second request was skipped; exactly one migration row remains

assertions.name: Production-built dashboard and navigation work at mobile width
assertions.evidence: 390×844 viewport rendered; account was loaded through GET /api/credits/1

assertions.name: Logout revokes the active database session
assertions.evidence: Logout revokes the server-side session; reuse of the old token returns 401

assertions.name: Daily scheduler logic updates the isolated database
assertions.evidence: Scheduler adds 5 credits to existing users and seeds a missing credits row

assertions.name: No uncaught browser JavaScript errors occurred
assertions.evidence: 0 page errors

assertions.name: All implemented frontend API operations were observed against the real backend
assertions.evidence: 21 browser-observed HTTP responses; no API route mocks
